English: Quarry Camp
A makeshift camp of tents and simple tools, where laborers break stone from the earth for basic city works.
Stonecutters Shed
A rough wooden shelter providing workspace for early stonecutters, increasing the flow and shaping of building stones.
Masons Lodge
A sturdy timber lodge with basic masonry tools, where workers gather for training and coordination of stone projects.
Stone Storehouse
A robust stone and timber warehouse, ensuring steady supplies of quarried material and improved construction logistics.
Chiselers Workshop
A dedicated stone workshop with advanced tools, enabling skilled craftsmen to refine blocks for city defenses and trade.
Masonry Guild
An organized guild hall for masons, overseeing large civic projects and elevating city prestige through fine stonework.
Stone Vaults
Subterranean stone vaults for secure storage, improving urban defense and economic stability.
Ashlar Works
A sophisticated stoneworks for the production of high-quality ashlar masonry, enabling grander civic and defensive architecture.
Stonemasons Hall
A prominent hall where master masons gather to train apprentices, coordinate city works, and shape urban policy.
Master Masonry Complex
A vast complex of guildhalls, workshops, and stoneworks. Here, the citys most skilled masons craft lasting monuments and fortifications, ensuring economic dominance and unrivaled urban defense.
